cases.name: setup: seed trace data
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_arch-test","case1",[{fn:"entry",file:"app.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"helper",file:"utils.ts",line:10,children:[]}]}],$root); ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"_arch-test","case2",[{fn:"entry",file:"app.ts",line:1,children:[{fn:"helper",file:"utils.ts",line:10,children:[]},{fn:"render",file:"ui.ts",line:5,children:[]}]}],$root); return true

cases.name: arch_trace json has all fields
cases.execute: const r = JSON.parse(await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"})); return r.logicLines !== undefined && r.impactGraph !== undefined && r.blindZones !== undefined

cases.name: arch_trace mermaid valid
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"mermaid"}); return r.startsWith("flowchart TD") && r.includes("-->")

cases.name: arch_trace json structured
cases.execute: const r = JSON.parse(await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"})); return Array.isArray(r.logicLines) && Array.isArray(r.impactGraph) && Array.isArray(r.blindZones)

cases.name: arch_trace dedup chains
cases.execute: const r = JSON.parse(await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"})); const chains = r.logicLines.map(l=>l.chain.join('|')); const unique = new Set(chains); return unique.size === chains.length

cases.name: arch_trace no traces hint
cases.execute: const r = JSON.parse(await $handlers.arch_trace()); return (r.hint && r.hint.includes("无 trace")) || (r.logicLines !== undefined && r.logicLines.length >= 0)

cases.name: arch_trace corrupt file skip
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); fs.writeFileSync($root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures/_corrupt.trace.json","not json"); const r = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"}); try{fs.unlinkSync($root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures/_corrupt.trace.json")}catch{} const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.logicLines !== undefined || d.hint !== undefined

cases.name: arch_trace diff commits noted
cases.execute: const r = JSON.parse(await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"})); return r.logicLines.every(l => Array.isArray(l.commits) && l.commits.length > 0)

cases.name: cleanup: remove test traces
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); try{fs.unlinkSync($root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures/_arch-test.trace.json")}catch{} return true

cases.name: CHK-007: blindZones detects arrow exports
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const testFile = path.join($root, "packages", "main", "src", "__test_blind.ts"); fs.writeFileSync(testFile, ["export const myArrow = async (x: number) => x * 2;","export function myFunc(x: number) { return x; }","export class MyClass { myMethod() { return 1; } }",""].join(String.fromCharCode(10))); try { const result = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"}); const parsed = JSON.parse(result); const zones = parsed.blindZones || []; const hasArrow = zones.some(z => z.includes("myArrow")); const hasFunc = zones.some(z => z.includes("myFunc")); const hasMethod = zones.some(z => z.includes("MyClass.myMethod")); return hasArrow && hasFunc && hasMethod; } finally { try { fs.rmSync(testFile); } catch {} }

cases.name: CHK-007: inner arrow not detected as export
cases.execute: const fs = await import("node:fs"); const path = await import("node:path"); const testFile = path.join($root, "packages", "main", "src", "__test_inner.ts"); fs.writeFileSync(testFile, ["export const wrapper = someHOF(() => { return 42; });","const internal = (x: number) => x;",""].join(String.fromCharCode(10))); try { const result = await $handlers.arch_trace({format:"json"}); const parsed = JSON.parse(result); const zones = parsed.blindZones || []; const hasWrapper = zones.some(z => z.includes("wrapper")); const hasInternal = zones.some(z => z.includes("internal")); return !hasWrapper && !hasInternal; } finally { try { fs.rmSync(testFile); } catch {} }
